top_signals.title: Global Food Prices Rise to Three-Year High
top_signals.summary: Global food prices edged higher in July to the highest in more than three years as renewed concerns over key grain export corridors compounded adverse weather across major growing regions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
